name: Wizard Dungeon
summary: Wizard Dungeon is an old school action rpg inspired by Diablo 1 and 2, with a unique pixel art style inspired by NES and Gameboy aesthetics. Grind through dungeon floors full of monsters, level up, spend skill points, equip items, and try to find a way out. Play the early access demo on itch for free! https://tonyhork.itch.io/wizard-dungeon
